app.title: RFID 125 kHz card reader/writer
tip.id:
The card ID in 8H10D format (10-digit decimal, no leading zeros).
E.g. 7439365
method.desc.t4100: T4100: writes rewritable T5577 cards in EM4100 format, emulates the EM4100 (most common mode). After "Lock", the chip rewritten via the "Unlock" button.
method.desc.e4100: E4100: writes EM4100-type cards. The classic EM4100 chip is not rewritable; this works only with some rewritable devices. If in doubt, try T4100.
method.desc.el4100: EL4100: writes EL4100-chip cards. Many devices do not support it; locking is unavailable in this mode. If in doubt, try T4100.

state.blank: Blank card: no programmed content (can be written)
log.blank.found: Blank card on the reader: no programmed content. Read finished.
log.blank.hint: The chip type and writability can be checked with the "Card status" button.
log.write.invalid: Invalid 8H10D value! Digits only, max 10 digits, between 0 and 4294967295 (no leading zeros).
log.write.start: Writing to card: 8H10D={0} | HEX={1} | DEC={2} | WG26={3} ...
log.write.place: (place the blank or rewritable card on the device)
log.cardinfo.start: Checking card status... (writability is verified with a safe probe write, then restored)
dlg.erase.title: Erase card
dlg.erase.text:
Erase the card's content?

The operation cannot be undone; the card becomes a blank, rewritable card.
log.erase.start: Erasing card... (place the card on the device)
log.erase.done: Done: card content erased (blank, rewritable card).
dlg.unlock.title: Unlock card
dlg.unlock.text:
Unlocking also erases the card content: the card becomes blank and rewritable.

Only works with cards locked by this device ("Lock after write"). Cards locked with a different password cannot be unlocked by the device.

Continue?
log.unlock.start: Unlocking card... (place the card on the device)
log.unlock.done: Done: card unlocked, content erased (blank, rewritable card).

err.erase.code: Erase error (code: 0x{0:X2}). The card may not be rewritable (read-only EM4100), or there is no card on the reader.
